notes.title: Power Update!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26183821/4dbe53dcec0698da4f0af1e471a7fe671b30bf39.png[/img]

We've just released a major update to Block Wave which includes lots of requested features from the community! 

4 modes of difficulty - We know people have had a hard time when first starting out to understand the controls. By starting out in easy you have a low pressure way of practicing. Level up to ultra for the ultimate challenge! 

New board types - Each mode of difficulty has a different style board. Check out Hard and Ultra for something totally different.

4 new songs - Composer Steve Page has created four awesome new songs to play to.

Bombs - Earn bombs for clearing rows and use them to destroy mistakes.

Block sliding - You can now slide pieces into spaces (instead of the block 'locking' into place right when you place it). As long as you keep the trigger button held down, you can slide your piece into holes in the board. 

Bug fixed & optimization - Squashed a handful of bugs and optimized for the best playing experience. 

Note - We spent a considerable amount of time working on natural hand block rotation using the Vive controllers. While it sounds obvious, so far it isn't a better way to play Block Wave. We continue to work on this, however, to make it easier for new players to pick the game up.

notes.title: HUGE update!
notes.content:
We just released a huge update to BLOCK WAVE VR and brought it out of early access. 

We've added all new early levels to make getting started easier and an in-game tutorial. 

Check it out and let us know your high scores!

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Block Wave VR, 10% off!
notes.content:
Block Wave VR is Now Available on Steam and is 10% off!*

Compete for the high score in this fast paced, addictive virtual reality block puzzler designed for the HTC Vive! Inspired by 1980’s Synthwave with an original score, Block Wave will keep you immersed for hours.

*Offer ends September 16 at 10AM Pacific Time

notes.title: Thank You & High Score Contest
notes.content:
Thanks to all our Day 1 fans! We're really excited to have Block Wave out in the world! While we have plenty of features we are working on adding, Block Wave is ready for action. 

We'll be implementing Steam scoreboards soon but in the mean time we want to see your high scores! Post screen shots in our discussion board of your high score and we'll be selecting some top Block Wavers to win Steam prizes!
